title: Seriously good cold-climate heat pumps are headed to the US market
summary: Electrek (2024): DOE Cold Climate Heat Pump Challenge units from eight makers heated real homes down to -15F and are reaching market.

assertions.quote: with some units operating at temperatures as low as –15F (–26C) while still meeting energy efficiency requirements.
These cold climate heat pumps (CCHPs) reliably delivered heat even during the coldest winter months
